Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class StoryGraphGenerator

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
public class StoryGraphGenerator extends Object implements edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
A tool for creating a story graph from a compiled Sabre problem. The story graph will have all the characters, fluents, and actions defined by the Sabre problem. Node 0 will be the problem's initial state. The graph will be generated using a complete breadth-first expansion (optionally limited to a certain depth). For every node, a temporal edge will be created for every action whose precondition is satisfied in that node's state. Every node which can be reached via any number of epistemic edges will also be generated.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
